text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Talk of a merger...?!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's about a group of acquaintances.
A video production company and a simulator development company are merging, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Our family is set to provide the venue for the commemorative ceremony and manage the whole event.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Both companies have incredible technology, don't they?
To be involved in such a momentous day...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ I'm looking forward to it already!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
("Merger Announced"
...It's already in the news!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (There are comments on the article too. Everyone must be feeling so excited...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
..."Won't one side just absorb and control the other?"
"It feels like both of their strong points will be erased."
"Is this merger bound to fail?"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I did anticipate that reactions like this would come up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: After all, with new endeavors, anxiety is directed at them just as much as anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Even so—having it written off as a "bad thing" right from the start just makes me feel... rather uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: I getcha! So you wanna clear up that gloomy funk, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes... I know it might seem self-serving, but I just can't settle down about it...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Sounds good to me! I totally dig that kind of feeling!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: So, if you're gonna do it, isn't giving them a direct "experience" showing "this is awesome synergy" the best move?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Once an image gets stuck in people's heads, plain logic won't overwrite it easily~. You gotta rebrand it with a killer impact!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Like, showing it off at an event! Something flashy with real drama!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: An event, you say... I see. That would certainly get the message across.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Managing the commemorative ceremony is our family's job. In that case, if we liven it up to the fullest...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...No, I want more. If we want to show that this "union" is truly a wonderful thing—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —...! ...Yes, this format might just be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, Father. We should order the cake from a famous pâtissier. Since this is an important milestone for both companies.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As for the favors... yes. Having them decided via a giant roulette wheel sounds fun too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We also need to prepare greeting letters properly. Asking the presidents of both sides...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Eek!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...! I got completely lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. A merger is taking place soon within a group of my father's acquaintances.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And I've ended up helping out with the commemorative ceremony celebrating their new departure!
choice_data_list: I see. Sounds like quite a large-scale project.
I see. Sounds like quite a large-scale project.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's not just an ordinary ceremony. After all, it's a "wedding" between companies.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Truth be told... there seem to be quite a few voices expressing anxiety over the merger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However, this merger is a wonderful thing that will create a new future. I wanted to show that—in a way that truly reaches their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The beauty of two separate entities becoming one. The most fitting form to showcase that is—
choice_data_list: ...I see. That's why it's a wedding, huh.
...I see. That's why it's a wedding, right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because a wedding is the format where a "union" looks the most beautiful.
choice_data_list: I'm rooting for it to go well.
I'm rooting for it to go well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because a wedding is the format where a "union" looks the most beautiful.
choice_data_list: I'm rooting for it to go well.
I'm rooting for it to go well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I will make sure it turns into a wonderful ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Into something that will surely make them think, "I'm glad they went through with that merger."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —No. I will definitely make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Being bold—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I believe that when they look back, it will become something that makes them feel "I'm glad it happened."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ Please look forward to it.
